what: A mob group's world lifecycle across a LOST fight: claimed (consumed) -> defeat RELEASES it back at its spot. Only a player victory consumes a group.
provenance: The mob_bitmap bytes of every step are the exact values asserted on chain by packages/move/aresrpg/tests/fight_door_tests.move::defeat_releases_the_group_and_the_rematch_lands (zones::mob_bitmap_for_testing). zones.move sets bit 0 at claim (bit_set) and clears it plus the trailing zero byte at release (bit_clear) - the client mirror reads these bytes verbatim.
